source.title: SYNTHETIC REHEARSAL ONLY — fictional training device

pages.text: This fictional training device has a safety latch and a green indicator. Before operation, inspect the safety latch and confirm the indicator is green. The safety latch inspection confirms that the latch is secured before operation. The green indicator confirms that the fictional training device is ready for operation. A common error is starting operation without inspecting the safety latch. Correct this error by inspecting the safety latch and checking the green indicator before operation. Record the safety check in the training log so the completed inspection can be reviewed. The coaching cue is: inspect the safety latch, confirm the green indicator, and record the safety check.
